business-data-analyst.label: Business / Data Analyst
business-data-analyst.description: Own a business area's numbers: pull data, build recurring and ad-hoc analysis, answer what happened and why.
business-data-analyst.work: Own a business area's numbers: pull data, build recurring and ad-hoc analysis, answer what happened and why.
business-data-analyst.gate: SQL fluency plus communication. The widest door in, and the most crowded.

bi-analyst.label: BI Analyst / BI Developer
bi-analyst.description: Design the semantic layer, build the dashboards the org runs on, define the metrics.
bi-analyst.work: Design the semantic layer, build the dashboards the org runs on, define the metrics.
bi-analyst.gate: SQL plus a BI platform plus data-modeling instinct.

product-analyst.label: Product Analyst / Product Data Scientist
product-analyst.description: Instrument and interpret a digital product: funnels, retention, A/B tests, metric definition.
product-analyst.work: Instrument and interpret a digital product: funnels, retention, A/B tests, metric definition.
product-analyst.gate: SQL plus experimentation literacy plus product sense.

data-scientist.label: Data Scientist
data-scientist.description: Build predictive and prescriptive models that ship, including the model lifecycle.
data-scientist.work: Build predictive and prescriptive models that ship, including the model lifecycle.
data-scientist.gate: Genuine Python plus ML fundamentals plus enough engineering to deploy.

analytics-engineer.label: Analytics Engineer
analytics-engineer.description: The layer between data engineering and analysis: transformation pipelines, warehouse design, testing.
analytics-engineer.work: The layer between data engineering and analysis: transformation pipelines, warehouse design, testing.
analytics-engineer.gate: Advanced SQL plus ETL/warehouse design plus software hygiene.

marketing-analyst.label: Marketing / Growth Analytics
marketing-analyst.description: Measure and optimise acquisition and retention: attribution, media mix, CRM, lifecycle testing.
marketing-analyst.work: Measure and optimise acquisition and retention: attribution, media mix, CRM, lifecycle testing.
marketing-analyst.gate: SQL plus causal/experimentation plus marketing vocabulary.

consultant.label: Analytics / Data Consultant
consultant.description: Parachute into client problems, scope them, deliver analysis, present to executives, move on.
consultant.work: Parachute into client problems, scope them, deliver analysis, present to executives, move on.
consultant.gate: Communication and structured problem-solving over technical depth.

fraud-risk-analyst.label: Risk & Fraud Analytics
fraud-risk-analyst.description: Build and monitor models that detect fraud, score credit, or quantify risk.
fraud-risk-analyst.work: Build and monitor models that detect fraud, score credit, or quantify risk.
fraud-risk-analyst.gate: ML modelling plus domain-specific feature construction.

operations-supply-chain.label: Supply Chain / Operations Analytics
operations-supply-chain.description: Forecasting, inventory optimisation, network and capacity planning, logistics analytics.
operations-supply-chain.work: Forecasting, inventory optimisation, network and capacity planning, logistics analytics.
operations-supply-chain.gate: Optimisation plus forecasting plus operations literacy.

pricing-analyst.label: Pricing & Revenue Management
pricing-analyst.description: Set and optimise prices: elasticity, willingness-to-pay, promotion and revenue management.
pricing-analyst.work: Set and optimise prices: elasticity, willingness-to-pay, promotion and revenue management.
pricing-analyst.gate: Econometrics plus pricing theory plus business judgement. Needs working R.

decision-scientist.label: Decision Scientist / Experimentation
decision-scientist.description: Causal inference as a job: design and analyse experiments, tell the org what actually caused what.
decision-scientist.work: Causal inference as a job: design and analyse experiments, tell the org what actually caused what.
decision-scientist.gate: Rigorous causal inference plus the political skill to deliver unwelcome findings.

ml-engineer.label: AI / ML Engineer & GenAI Solutions
ml-engineer.description: Build and deploy ML and LLM systems: retrieval pipelines, model serving, evaluation, agentic workflows.
ml-engineer.work: Build and deploy ML and LLM systems: retrieval pipelines, model serving, evaluation, agentic workflows.
ml-engineer.gate: The steepest gate: real software engineering plus deep learning plus systems thinking.

healthcare-analyst.label: Healthcare / Life Sciences Analytics
healthcare-analyst.description: Claims and clinical analytics, HEOR, commercial analytics for pharma and devices, population health.
healthcare-analyst.work: Claims and clinical analytics, HEOR, commercial analytics for pharma and devices, population health.
healthcare-analyst.gate: Analytics fundamentals plus domain vocabulary and regulatory context.

finance-quant.label: Financial Analytics
finance-quant.description: Forecasting and planning, corporate finance analytics, investment and treasury analytics.
finance-quant.work: Forecasting and planning, corporate finance analytics, investment and treasury analytics.
finance-quant.gate: Forecasting and time series plus financial domain fluency.
